title: Continuously shrink binary size & startup time
description:
Project rule: speed and size are permanent priorities, not one-time targets. After every dependency change or feature, re-measure exe size and cold-start.

Concrete levers to investigate, ordered by likely payoff:

1. Static-link SQLite — vendor sqlite3.c amalgamation, compile via cl.exe in MSBuild BeforeTargets="LinkNative", DirectPInvoke + NativeLibrary. Eliminates e_sqlite3.dll (-1.7MB file count, ~+700KB into exe).
2. Drop ANGLE (av_libglesv2.dll, 5.2MB) — Win32PlatformOptions { CompositionMode = [Software / Direct2D1] }. Validate rendering quality on older GPUs, RDP, VMs before committing.
3. Surface individual trim warnings (TrimmerSingleWarn=false) — see what Microsoft.Data.Sqlite drags in via reflection; add TrimmerRoots / DynamicDependency to root only what's needed.
4. Profile the published exe with sizoscope (https://github.com/MichalStrehovsky/sizoscope) — find unexpected size hogs in our own assembly tree.
5. Try IlcDisableReflection=true — aggressive; risk of breaking Avalonia at runtime. Validate carefully against compiled XAML bindings.
6. Custom TrimmerRoot fine-tuning — explicit roots for SQLite types we use; remove auto-rooted assemblies we don't need.
7. Re-measure after Avalonia patch bumps (11.3.x) — their footprint changes between releases.

Acceptance: any change here must be validated by (a) exe size before/after in bytes, (b) cold-start to first paint before/after, (c) a clean run of the app with multiple notes. No regressions to startup time, ever.

title: AOT single-file publish
description: dotnet publish -r win-x64 -c Release -p:PublishAot=true. Target: <25MB single-file exe, no .NET install required, cold start <300ms. May need TrimmerRootDescriptor + DirectPInvoke tweaks for Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.
close_reason: AOT publish working. Stickies.exe = 15.5MB (under 25MB target). Size-tuning: Fluent theme dropped for Simple, Inter font dropped for system, IlcOptimizationPreference=Size + DebuggerSupport/EventSourceSupport/MetadataUpdaterSupport off. True single-file not pursued (Avalonia native deps Skia/HarfBuzz/ANGLE cannot reasonably be static-linked); ships as exe + 4 platform DLLs. SQLite static-link is a separate follow-up.

title: Single-instance enforcement
description: Mutex 'Local\Stickies.SingleInstance' + named pipe 'Stickies.IPC'. Second launch writes verb (NEW/SHOW/OPEN:<id>) and exits; running instance dispatches via Dispatcher.UIThread.Post. ShutdownMode = OnExplicitShutdown.
close_reason: Mutex + named pipe shipped; verbs SHOW/NEW/OPEN:<id>; verified end-to-end (3 existing notes loaded, --new routed via pipe to spawn 4th, second launch exits in <400ms, process count stays at 1)

title: WiX v5 MSI installer (perUser, no UAC)
description: WixToolset.Sdk MSBuild SDK. Scope=perUser. Installs Stickies.exe to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Stickies, Start Menu shortcut. No code-signing for v1 (SmartScreen warning expected). Depends on AOT publish.

title: Global hotkey (Win+Shift+N spawns note)
description: Win32 RegisterHotKey via [LibraryImport]. MOD_WIN | MOD_SHIFT + VK_N. Hidden message-pump Window receives WM_HOTKEY (0x0312) via Win32Properties.AddWndProcHookCallback. AOT-clean.
close_reason: HotkeyHost (1x1 invisible Window) registers Win+Shift+N via RegisterHotKey + AddWndProcHookCallback. Verified end-to-end: hotkey spawns a new note. AOT-clean (LibraryImport).

title: Right-click context menu on note
description: Consolidate Pin / New / Delete (and future Color, Export, etc.) into a right-click ContextMenu on the note body. Replaces or supplements current keybindings.
close_reason: ContextMenu attached to root Border with New note (Ctrl+N) / Delete (Ctrl+D); existing keybindings preserved via shared DeleteNote() helper. Also folded in default Topmost=True per user direction.

title: Always-on-top toggle (per-note pin)
description: Add per-note 'topmost' pin. Persisted in DB (new column 'pinned'). UI: right-click menu or keybinding. Avalonia Window.Topmost = true.
close_reason: Pinned column + menu toggle. Notes default pinned (matches rt1 baseline). Verified: toggle drops/raises Topmost, menu header updates, persists across restart.

title: Replace native ChooseColor with a nicer custom picker
description:
The native Win32 ChooseColor dialog used by the '…' swatch (Stickies-265) works and is AOT-clean / zero-binary-cost, but the UI is dated (Win95-era look). User flagged this as a future polish item.

Options to evaluate:
1. Custom Avalonia popup — small HSV/HSL surface + hex input. Most code, full control, no new deps.
2. Expanded preset palette (e.g. 32 colors in a 4×8 grid) — replace ChooseColor entirely with a richer palette inside the existing menu. No modal dialog. Trade: no truly arbitrary color.
3. Avalonia.Controls.ColorPicker NuGet package — easy, but measure binary-size delta and confirm AOT compatibility before committing.

Decide via Stickies-d0q's lens: what's the size cost vs. UX gain. Option 2 is probably the sweet spot.

title: Per-note color
description: Add 'color' column to notes. Default yellow #FFF59E. Picker in context menu — small preset palette (yellow, pink, blue, green, gray). Header strip auto-derives a darker shade.
close_reason: 5 presets + custom picker via Win32 ChooseColor shipped. User confirms colors apply, header auto-darkens, custom picker opens. UX of native dialog tracked for revisit in Stickies-har.

title: Full-text search across notes (FTS5)
description: SQLite FTS5 virtual table mirroring notes.text via triggers, tokenize='trigram'. Search bar in a manager/search window. Highlights matching note(s).

title: Export note(s) to .md / .txt
description: Per-note or bulk export via TopLevel.GetTopLevel(this)?.StorageProvider.OpenFolderPickerAsync. .md adds YAML frontmatter (created/updated). AOT-clean.

title: Recycle bin / undelete UI
description: View soft-deleted notes (deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC). Restore moves deleted_at back to NULL. Hard delete via DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=. Optional 30-day auto-purge.
